## Report issue

Note: please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/zh-CN/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud ship stable builds; nightly-supported models may not be included yet, please wait for the next stable release.

- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

An elderly man with weathered features sits by the water's edge at sunset, holding up a fishing net in his hands as he gazes directly at the camera with a gentle smile, The scene is bathed in warm golden light reflecting off the calm surface of the lake or sea, which stretches to distant hills under a soft sky—creating an atmosphere filled with quiet contentment and timelessness, The image captures not just physical age but also emotional depth; every wrinkle around his eyes tells stories of years spent catching fish, while his hands show signs of use from decades of work, His grey hair stands out against the pale background, and the simple yet meaningful gesture suggests wisdom passed down through generations—a moment frozen between labor and reflection.

A young woman with dark skin and long braids stands in profile against a softly lit window, her face illuminated by dappled sunlight filtering through sheer curtains, The light creates intricate patterns of bright highlights across her features, casting gentle shadows along her cheekbones and neck while highlighting the vibrant colors of her patterned shirt—rich blues, reds, yellows—and adding texture to her hair, The scene is calm and contemplative, evoking an intimate moment where quiet observation meets natural beauty, Her stillness suggests introspection as she gazes thoughtfully towards something beyond the frame—a subtle interplay between soft illumination and deep shadow enhances both the emotional tone and physical detail of this portrait.

The background fades to muted greens and browns, emphasizing the butterfly as the sole focus—a quiet moment suspended between life and nature’s artistry.

nodes.title: 📜 CR Prompt  animals 6
widgets_values:
A close-up portrait captures a male lion with an intense gaze directed forward, The lion's mane is thick and shaggy, displaying shades of brown and tan that appear weathered from the outdoors, Its eyes are wide open, glowing with a golden-yellow hue that stands out against its dark fur, The animal has a slightly rugged appearance with dirt specks on its snout and muzzle, suggesting it may have been in active use or was recently exposed to harsh conditions, It opens its mouth slightly, revealing sharp teeth and fangs—its jawline prominent under the light, Whiskers extend outward from either side of its nose, adding texture to the face.

A close-up portrait captures a wolf with alert eyes looking slightly to the right of the frame, Its fur displays a mix of brown, grey, and white tones across its head, neck, and body, forming natural patterns that blend into each other, The animal's ears are erect, showing attention and awareness, Its golden-yellow eyes gleam subtly under soft light, conveying focus and intelligence, A dark nose contrasts sharply against the lighter muzzle area where whiskers appear faintly blurred in motion or texture, The wolf’s face shows subtle tension as it gazes forward with an intense gaze—its jaw set lightly but firmly closed, The setting appears to be outdoors during daylight hours, possibly late morning or early afternoon given the even illumination without harsh shadows, Background colors fade gently from greenish-grey on the left side toward softer browns and muted yellows on the far-right edge, suggesting open grassland terrain behind the subject. 

In a festive indoor arena, an anthropomorphic gorilla in full boxing gear stands poised within the confines of a ring with blue matting and red-and-white ropes, The creature has dark fur covering its body, thick arms, and wears black gloves marked "WARRIOR" on one wristband—its stance suggests readiness for combat as it faces off against a snowman dressed festively in a Santa hat, scarf, and small stick nose, Snowflakes are scattered mid-air between them like confetti from a sudden punch, creating dynamic motion that adds to the scene’s energy, The snowman holds a tiny wooden wand topped with a bright-red heart-shaped cap, adding whimsy to this unusual clash. Its eyes glow white dots and face features two buttons each at chest level, while another button sits above its head—a classic representation of simple charm,
The setting appears to be during winter holidays or Christmas festivities—an event space filled with spectators seated along the sides of the stage under overhead spotlights, Bright lights illuminate the center, casting sharp highlights across both characters’ forms but also leaving parts of their surroundings slightly dimmer, These artificial sources create high contrast and hard-edged light patterns which emphasize textures—the rough fur of the gorilla versus smooth rounded shapes of the snowman—and contribute significantly to the dramatic tension created by the impending impact, A few audience members are partially seen behind the barrier, focused intently on the spectacle unfolding before them—all appearing young adults wearing casual attire including hats typical of seasonal wear, Camera perspective seems elevated slightly toward the middle ground, allowing viewers to see into depth clearly without losing focus on either main figure. Composition places the gorilla centrally left-hand side relative to the frame's right edge where the snowman stands symmetrically aligned near the corner post line, emphasizing movement and balance amid chaos caused by falling flakes. Overall atmosphere combines humor, action sports flair, holiday cheer all wrapped up together through creative visual storytelling.
